name: oxen-meter
description: Measures the prompt cache for a team, in Claude Code and, with its command-line companion, Codex CLI and Devin CLI: hit rate per session, subagent and model, a warning before a cold resume re-sends a whole context, the quota each session used, and an anonymized export to pool cost and quota data. Records token counts and timings only, never prompts, code or paths.

resumeGuard.title: Cold resume guard
resumeGuard.description: Before Claude resumes a subagent whose prompt cache has likely gone cold: warn shows a toast, ask lets you spawn a fresh agent instead, off only records it.

coldTokens.title: Cold resume tokens
coldTokens.description: How large a context must be, in tokens, before re-writing it counts as a cold resume.

mainTtl.title: Main thread cache TTL
mainTtl.description: How long the main thread's prompt cache lives: auto uses the TTL the meter measured or inferred (1h until it has samples).

subagentTtl.title: Subagent cache TTL
subagentTtl.description: How long a subagent's prompt cache lives: auto uses the TTL the meter measured or inferred (5m until it has samples).

userLabel.title: Your label
userLabel.description: The name your exports carry in the team report, such as a nickname. Empty: anonymous.

hashProject.title: Hash project names
hashProject.description: Keep the project as a hash in the records instead of its folder name.

outputWeight.title: Output weight
outputWeight.description: What one output token weighs against one uncached input token in the token equivalent.

retentionDays.title: Keep sessions (days)
retentionDays.description: Session files older than this are emptied. The meter cannot delete files, so an emptied file stays as a few bytes.

dataDir.title: Data folder
dataDir.description: An absolute path to the folder the meter writes its sessions and exports to. Empty: oxen-meter in the .claude folder the plugin is installed under.

cachedWeight.title: Cached input weight (Codex, Devin)
cachedWeight.description: What one cached input token of Codex or Devin weighs against an uncached one, as its model's price list has it. Claude's cache is priced by the meter itself.

coldAfterMin.title: Cold after (minutes, Codex and Devin)
coldAfterMin.description: How long a Codex or Devin thread may sit before the oxen-meter CLI's hooks warn that its prompt cache is likely gone. Their caches have no fixed TTL; /meter report shows how yours held.
